messages:
nina: Quick question. I'm attending a workshop in Lisbon (Apr 8-9) and bringing my partner for sightseeing. I booked one room for Apr 7-10 on my company card. Company covers Apr 8-9 nights only. How do I split the folio and handle per diem for shared meals? cc @travel-ops

james: Short answer: company pays lodging for business nights only and per diem for the employee. Personal companion costs and incremental charges are on you.

travel-ops: Process: ask front desk for an itemized folio showing nightly rates. If hotel won't split, submit a single folio plus a short attestation that singles out business nights and partner stay. Create two expenses in Expensify: one with business nights (attached folio or attestation) and one personal.

nina: For meals: partner shared dinner cost was 60; my portion 35. Can I claim my 35?

finance-bot: Yes, you can claim the employee's share of meals during business travel. Upload receipt, annotate split (employee share 35) and include conference invite. Per diem applies only to the employee; companions do not get per diem.

james: Note on VAT: if partner's portion was charged on the same bill, mark that line as personal and include explanation. Also avoid charging incidental extras (mini-bar, in-room movies) to the company card.

nina: Thanks. One more: partner used the room and added a tourist tram ticket to the folio by mistake. They refunded it at checkout but the folio shows original then refund line. Is that fine?

travel-ops: That's fine. Attach the folio with the refund line and add a short note "refund of tram ticket - personal". Finance will net it automatically.

nina: Great, I'll request itemized folio and split it in Expensify. Appreciate the help :blush:
